---

PATTERN: 5-state machine for FN key handling

COMPONENTS:
- Idle: default, FN ignored if not mapped
- FnHeld: entered on FN press if any action maps to bare FN. has since (timestamp), shortcut_fired (bool), was_toggle_active (bool)
- PushToTalkActive: recording via hold-to-talk. FN release or key-up stops it
- ToggleRecordingActive: recording via toggle. FN release does NOT stop it. Second FN hold > 300ms stops it
- CommandModeActive: cloud command mode. Same hold-to-talk behavior as PTT

DOCS:
- docs/hotkey-state-machine.md — Mermaid diagrams (renders on GitHub/VS Code)
- docs/hotkey-state-machine.svg — rendered SVG (open in browser to zoom)
- docs/hotkey-state-machine.dot — graphviz source

WHY: Previous design had no ToggleRecordingActive — toggle relied on PushToTalkActive which incorrectly stopped on FN release

REJECTED: Global shortcut system is stateless (direct dispatch, no coordinator) — only FN-based bindings go through this state machine
